capabilities: Commit and push vault changes in one click
Pull and push for full bidirectional sync
Clone a vault from a GitHub repository inside the app
Show a Git status side panel with checkboxes and masked token handling
extras: The interface and commands are in Spanish; the full manual lives in a separate MANUAL.md rather than the README. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Característica / Feature | GitFacil | Plugin de Git Convencional
motivation: The author built it for users of all types, from beginners who do not know how to program to advanced users wanting instant, reliable sync.
problem: Using Git with Obsidian normally requires terminal commands and CLI tools, and mobile support typically depends on Termux, which excludes non-developers.

relations.evidence: GitFacil opera 100% de forma local y directa con tus repositorios de GitHub.
Motor puro en JavaScript (isomorphic-git) optimizado con el adaptador de archivos de Obsidian

requires.name: Native Git executable (desktop only; mobile uses isomorphic-git)

summary: Git backup plugin that commits, pushes, pulls and clones an Obsidian vault to GitHub in one click, without terminal commands, on desktop and mobile.
